description_en: Binds paid domain names in Alibaba Cloud DNS to an instance ID
description_zh: 绑定付费版DNS域名到实例ID
kebab_example: aliyun alidns bind-instance-domains --instance-id s00000000 --domain-names example.com,example.net --region cn-hangzhou
name: BindInstanceDomains

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

zh: Chinese

en: English

Default value: zh
parameters.help_zh:
返回值语言，取值：
zh：中文
en：英文

默认：zh
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud DNS instance. You can call the ListCloudGtmInstances (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-listcloudgtminstances) operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh:
权威域名实例ID（域名绑定的产品实例ID）。<props="china">可通过调用ListCloudGtmInstances (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-listcloudgtminstances?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-search-29697.d_0)获取</props>
<props="intl">可通过调用ListCloudGtmInstances (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-listcloudgtminstances?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-search-29697.d_0)获取</props>
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
A list of domain names.

Separate multiple domain names with a comma (,). You can specify up to 100 domain names
parameters.help_zh:
域名列表。

英文 " , ” 号隔开多个域名，最多100个域名
parameters.name: domain_names

FailedCount.description_en: The number of domain names that failed to be bound

SuccessCount.description_en: The number of domain names that were successfully bound
